# DaySight MCP

> DaySight MCP is a Workday MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that lets an AI assistant answer workforce analytics questions about a Workday tenant in plain English, with charts and dashboards. It runs as a desktop extension on the user's own computer, signs in with the user's own Workday account and returns aggregates only. Source-available, free for non-commercial use (PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0). Independent project, not affiliated with Workday, Inc.

## Pages

- [Home](https://daysight.dev/): what it is and how it works
- [Features](https://daysight.dev/features.html): workforce analytics, charts, dashboards and the Workday areas covered
- [Examples](https://daysight.dev/examples.html): sample questions to ask
- [Demos](https://daysight.dev/demos.html): short recorded demos
- [Install](https://daysight.dev/install.html): setup steps for Claude Desktop on Windows
- [Security](https://daysight.dev/security.html): access model, privacy and what stays local
